title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Lemon Mint 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Take your taste buds on a thrilling ride with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fill's Lemon Mint. This extraordinary e-liquid skilfully combines the tanginess of fresh lemons with the cool, invigorating hint of mint, creating an unforgettable vaping sensation from the first inhale to the last. The initial puff introduces a burst of lemon that's as close to the real fruit as it gets—tangy, bright, and incredibly authentic. This zestiness is an instant mood booster, setting you up for the exciting twist that follows. Just when you think you’ve got the flavour pinned down, a wave of mint sweeps in, adding a refreshing layer to the zesty lemon. It's a delightful contrast, like sipping on a lemon-mint cooler on a hot summer day. The mint doesn’t overpower but perfectly complements the citrus, giving you a well-rounded vape that's both vibrant and relaxing. So if you're looking to add a bit of zest to your vaping routine or simply want a flavour that keeps you guessing, Lemon Mint is your go-to e-liquid. Its harmonious blend of tart and cool notes makes it a perfect all-day vape that never loses its appeal. Discover unparalleled vaping bliss with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Pod Fills. Boasting ten mouth-watering, double-concentrated flavours, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to tantalise your taste buds while keeping nicotine cravings at bay. Unique in their 50/50 VG/PG blend, Pod Fills are versatile, ideal for Starter Kits , MTL Pod Kits , and devices with coils of 0.8ohm or higher. Enjoy the convenience of a 100ml shortfill bottle, complete with 20ml of extra space for your preferred nicotine shot. For instance, add 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots to create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid.
